name: Heart-Shaped Herb
oracle_text:
If a source an opponent controls would deal damage to you, prevent 1 of that damage.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You may sacrifice a creature. If you do, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control with three +1/+1 counters on it and you become the monarch.
blocked_sentences: If a source an opponent controls would deal damage to you, prevent 1 of that damage

needs.what: a static prevention shield on a player: each time a source matching a dealer filter (here controller: opponent, read off the dealer's controller in any zone) would deal damage to the seat named by affects_player (you), prevent N of that damage (N = 1), per source and per damage event
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The 'prevent_damage' static (amount / prevent_all) is read only by characteristics.prevented_damage and prevents_all_damage, which answer damage to a permanent via 'affects' and never to a player, and it cannot carry 'damage_source' (the loader allows that key only on replace_damage). 'prevent_all_but' caps damage to a player but has no dealer filter and caps rather than subtracting. 'replace_damage' takes damage_source and affects_player but only multiplies by 2 or more. The 'prevent_damage' op is a one-shot with a duration, not a lasting static.
